paper.title: EvoTest: Evolutionary Test-Time Learning for Self-Improving Agentic Systems
paper.central_claim: EvoTest利用整轨迹叙事反馈对提示、记忆、推断超参和工具例程做整系统演化，在J-TTL快速自我改进并优于反思/提示演化及在线RL。

provenance.notes: 派发model type=sonnet，配置映射gpt-6.1-sol；无独立可验证运行回执/会话标识，actual_model按模板保留null，不探测。未读取其他席/attempt/批次或裁决。

sections_read: Appendices A–N (including master prompt, cases, complexity, five-seed results)

evidence.quote: This configuration rewrites the prompt, updates memory by logging effective state–action choices, tunes hyperparameters, and learns the tool-use routines.
evidence.support_explanation: 原主张：不更新权重的整配置演化，反馈后留存到下一episode。

evidence.quote: EvoTest generalizes prompt evolution to whole-system evolution, optimizing the entire agentic configuration—including the prompt, memory, hyperparameters, and tool-use routines.
evidence.support_explanation: 与Promptbreeder/EvoPrompt的作者侧差异；邻居原文尚未独立核对。

evidence.quote: After each episode concludes, the game environment is reset to its identical initial state,
evidence.support_explanation: 每轮同游戏同初始状态；不是跨任务独立留出。

evidence.quote: Instead of forcing the LLM to re-read the entire history, this tool parses the log for key environmental cues
evidence.support_explanation: 可变state extractor用于后续每步状态摘要，而非只是一次回答反思。

evidence.quote: is then inherited by all child configurations.
evidence.support_explanation: 成功/停滞记忆由该轮轨迹抽取并继承；未见独立记忆效用准入。

evidence.quote: At the start of each new episode, the UCB algorithm selects a single configuration, which is then used for the entire duration of that episode. The episode’s final score is then used to update the statistics for that chosen configuration.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行结果更新均值和计数后影响后续选择；UCB分配不是独立回归认证。

evidence.quote: The UCB rule can then naturally “fall back” to the time-tested parent, which retains its high score.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者描述保留父配置以回退；永久历史档案、冷启动和非法代码处理不清。

evidence.quote: EvoTest achieves the highest AUC score on all six games, with an average score of 0.47/0.50—a significant improvement over the next best baseline, EvoPrompt (0.34/0.36).
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告两演员下同游戏学习AUC收益；significant字样不等于统计检验。

evidence.locator: Table 3 rows Full, w/o Prompt, w/o UCB
evidence.support_explanation: 三游戏消融显示prompt与UCB重要；同表memory/hyperparameter/tool-use亦有消融，后两差距小。

evidence.quote: EvoTest (Avg. AUC 0.35) outperforms the strongest weight-update baseline, GRPO (0.31).
evidence.support_explanation: 同Qwen actor+evolver缩小基座混杂；o3版本0.40仍有更强优化器。

evidence.quote: A fine-tuning pass on one episode’s data took 5 to 10 minutes on 4 H100 GPUs.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告局部更新硬件/时间；EvoTest每次1调用20–30秒，非完整token/$预算配平。

明确任务实例过拟合；不能以循环次数当独立留存迁移证据。

claims.text: 整配置演化在J-TTL比提示/反思/在线RL更快且稳定学习。
claims.setting: 6 Jericho游戏；每session K=50 episode，每轮T=110，同初态重置；Gemini/Claude演员、o3 Evolver
claims.selection_vs_test: 每轮结果既驱动后续选择又计入AUC；无独立实例冻结产物测试
claims.result: 主表平均AUC .47/.50 vs EvoPrompt .34/.36；Appendix F Gemini五种子 .48±.01；同Qwen双方 .35 vs GRPO .31
claims.denominator: 6游戏×50轮×110步上限；Appendix F主结果5种子；部分消融3游戏
counterevidence: 主结果演员与RL基座不同；同Qwen补充只3游戏且非总预算匹配
只测同实例战略过拟合，不证独立留存迁移或improver自我改进
Appendix F部分baseline均值与主表差异较大：Memory Detective .56 vs主表 .25，运行口径未解释
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者报告标准得分下重复同游戏的任务学习优势；不证明一般新技能、迁移或同成本优势。

claims.text: 梯度自由整系统更新更实用高效。
claims.setting: Table2局部更新延迟、Appendix E符号复杂度
claims.baseline_control: 每轮在线SFT/GRPO 4H100 vs API mutation；acting未做统一硬件/价格核算
claims.selection_vs_test: 成本报告对应更新步骤非冻结策略独立测试
claims.result: EvoTest每次1调用20–30秒；权重更新5–10分钟4H100
claims.denominator: single learning update；未报全会话token/$及失败子代分母
counterevidence: 远程API计算并非免费，o3优化器费用可能昂贵
同环境步预算不等于同总计算预算
claims.allowed_conclusion: 指定实现局部更新延迟较短；不能宣称全面计算/金钱效率被控制验证。

rationale: 整轨迹驱动四组件写回与UCB有多基线/组件消融，附录报告五种子主结果。同游戏重试是学习与选择流，非独立迁移；总计算配平、代码/版本恢复与跨表统计口径仍不足。
